summary: Master commercial lease administration, IFRS 16 compliance, and CAM reconciliations. Gain practical skills in lease abstraction and portfolio risk management.
lede: Commercial real estate contract and lease management turns lease terms into reliable portfolio and financial records. Designed for professionals managing commercial, industrial or retail property, it teaches them to abstract leases, reconcile operating expenses, audit rent rolls, identify risky clauses, track renewal, expansion and termination dates, and prepare executive reports.
audienceIntro: This program is specifically designed for professionals who manage commercial, industrial, or retail real estate assets and must ensure both legal compliance and financial optimization.
modules: Real Estate Contract Law and Structure
Critical Date Management and Tenant Options
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2-3 years of experience in property management, asset management, or corporate real estate. A basic understanding of commercial lease terminology and financial accounting principles is required. Familiarity with Microsoft Excel for financial calculations is highly recommended.
